situation (example wording): "What states are not represented?" (and the same asked other ways)
what the app does today: Listed the states with no NIBRS data, then a second column of other places (DC, Guam, Puerto Rico, U.S. Virgin Islands) with none, and said "every state and the District of Columbia".
proposed behavior: The answer counts the 50 states only. DC, Puerto Rico and the territories are not states and get no line or column. A state is listed in a year when none of its agencies reported any month (the any-month rule); when none is missing the answer says "every one of the 50 states has reporting agencies". The Source line stays FBI NIBRS.
why: Jeff 2026-11-25 (typed in the Coordinator session): "DC, PR and USVI shouldn't count as states".
status: Decided (Jeff 2026-11-25). Open: his note that state questions start in 1960; the NIBRS agency lists begin with the release's first year, so the answer covers the years held and states that span.
test cases: scripts/test-nibrs-coverage.ts (states rows, text lines, no DC/PR/territory words).
